description: Fixed scenario-ID namespaces. A scenario ID is '<namespace>.<kebab-name>'. Each namespace has ONE owner and ONE committed ID list in contract/ids/<namespace>.json, so parallel work adds scenarios in separate files. A scenario module may only define IDs in a namespace that is allowed for its host.
